a specific inhibitor of cellulase, 2, 6-dichloro benzonitrile, increases the amount of cel A1 protein and that the crystallizability of cellulose micro fibrils is inhibited.

the quantity of celA protein in the microsomal fraction was increased in tobacco BY- 2 cells habituated to a cellulose biosynthetic inhibitor, 2- 6-dichloronitrobenzene, and the amount of polysacchrides in the EDTA - soluble fraction was relatively increased.

In summary, our research is concerned with
the molecular mechanisms of cellulose biosynthetic machinery.
the regulation of the amount of cellulose synthases in tobacco BY- 2 cells, which is one of the most important factors in the control of cellulose biosynthetic process.
the biochemical analysis of cellulase and cellulose biosynthesis in plants.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the cellulose biosynthesis inhibitors, such as 2,6-DCB and isoxaben, inhibit the crystallization of the cellulose microfbrils and stabilize celA1 protein.
cellulose synthases are not inhibited by DCB, but rather are stabilized by it.
the cellulose biosynthesis is regulated by the amount of cellulose synthases.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the celA1 protein, a catalytic sub-unit of cellulose synthases, is stabilized by binding to a cellulose biosynthetic inhibitor, 2.6-dichloro-benzonitrile (DCB).
DCB inhibits the crystallization of the cellulose microf fibrils by binding to the celA1 protein, and this binding causes the accumulation of celA1.
the celA1 protein, the catalytic subunit, is stabilized upon DCBs binding, and that the DCB binding to the catalytic subunits inhibits the crystallization of the microfibrils.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the celA1 protein, which is a component of cellulose synthases in higher plants, was detected by a specific antibody in microsomal fractions of BY-2 cells treated with 2,6-DCB, and the amount of the protein was increased in these cells.
DCB treatment of tobacco BY- 2 cells causes an increase in the amount of the celA1 protein.
DCB is a specific inhibitor of cellulase biosynthesis.
